```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Title and subtitle say what is shown; highlighting carries the takeaway.
# Use ggiraph's *_interactive geoms with a tooltip so the page can be probed.
d <- tbl(con, "picks") |>
  count(position) |>
  collect() |>
  slice_max(n, n = 10)

p <- ggplot(d, aes(n, reorder(position, n))) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = paste0(position, ": ", fmt(n)))) +
  labs(
    title = "What the figure shows",
    subtitle = paste("Who and when; the", nrow(d), "largest groups"),
    x = "Reader-facing axis label",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "{{id}}", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: card-footer
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
cat(card_footer())
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
